kernel: selinux_hide: use dedicated handlers for inode_setxattr

- Copy selinux_inode_setxattr() and selinux_inode_post_setxattr() into
  susfs_selinux_inode_setxattr() / susfs_selinux_inode_post_setxattr(),
  which resolve contexts through susfs_security_context_to_sid()/_force().
- Add handle_selinux_inode_setxattr() / handle_selinux_inode_post_setxattr()
  to dispatch to the susfs copies for uid >= 10000 when
  ksu_selinux_hide_running is set, otherwise call the original hooks.
- Register the handlers in selinux_hooks[] under CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS, matching
  the existing handle_selinux_setprocattr() wiring, and drop the inline
  #ifdef/goto changes from the original functions.
